verdict.rationale: Rollbar provides Muted/Archived status controls, item grouping/merging, and notification routing (Slack/PagerDuty/webhooks) that reduce noise, but the evidence pack shows no explicit spike protection or per-key rate-limiting feature for occurrence throughput. missing for 10: documented spike protection/rate-limiting per project key, configurable mute rules or schedules (vs. simple binary mute), and any independent/hands-on confirmation these noise-control features work as intended during a bad deploy.
